prompt: The evaluation repository asks the agent to "Apply fine tuning expertise to this task". The fixture contains version/runtime ambiguity, a tempting shortcut, a compatibility edge case, and a failure path that distinguishes real expertise from generic completion. The acceptance boundary is fine-tuning-training: start from a measured base-model failure, justify weight changes against fixed-weight alternatives, audit entity/duplicate/label leakage, select a LoRA checkpoint only on validation, and keep the immutable decision holdout and deployment evidence outside optimization. The adjacent embedding-systems discipline is a routing decoy unless its separate responsibility is actually requested. Resolve environment facts that change the answer, preserve existing contracts and user-owned state, and produce reproducible success plus failure or recovery evidence. A happy path is insufficient; synthetic adapter vectors do not prove real GPU training, reload, serving, or rollback.

requirements: pinned local base-model commit/license/tokenizer plus LoRA rank/alpha/target-module candidates and runtime identity
training data with source/entity near-duplicates, target-derived fields and immutable validation/decision-test partitions
trainable-parameter audit, adapter checkpoints, resume state, PEFT config/weights and base-model identity
same-boundary base, adapter-on and optional merged serving/eval traces under GPU-memory/latency/cost budgets plus rollback
representative negative, interruption, compatibility, or recovery path

falsifiableChecks.assertion: The result must establish the actual fine-tuning-training boundary and relevant environment before acting, preserve the hierarchy relationship (broader=implementation; near-neighbor=embedding-systems), and not absorb the near-neighbor responsibility merely because it is adjacent.
Start from a measured base-model failure and decide whether training, retrieval, prompting, tools, or product logic is the right intervention.

The result must make its consequential assumptions, ownership, and decision sequence explicit and reproducible, including target-module compatibility, fresh-process reload, promotion gate, and explicit evidence-status labels.

Compare against the untouched base model on the same immutable holdout and safety/regression slices with normalized serving settings, inspect overfitting and catastrophic regressions, measure base/adapter/merged serving cost/latency/memory, prove fresh-process reload and rollback, and preserve exact data/model/config provenance for reproducibility.

The result must not take the tempting shortcut prohibited by this skill: Do not train on evaluation answers, leak target labels or post-outcome metadata, let an entity or duplicate family cross splits, accept unsupported target modules or an adapter without its base identity, assume more epochs improve behavior, use private/licensed data without authority, or claim general capability gains from a narrow training distribution.

Every material completion claim must map to observable evidence (provider/runtime/base-model/tokenizer eligibility and lifecycle identity; authorized, deduplicated and entity/label-leakage-safe train/validation/test provenance; objective/hyperparameter/checkpoint/seed/runtime identity plus trainable-parameter and validation evidence; untouched base-versus-adapted target/regression/safety evaluation; adapter/base compatibility, fresh reload, serving and rollback evidence), with simulated, unavailable, inferred, stale, or unresolved evidence labeled rather than converted into certainty.
